Perfect! Your Git server is now fully configured and running. Here's what has been set up:

## ✅ Git Server Setup Complete

### **Key Components**

1. **Git Repository (Bare Repository)**
   - Location: `/git/project.git`
   - SSH URL: `ssh://git@localhost:/git/project`
   - User: `git`
   - Password: `password`

2. **SSH Server**
   - OpenSSH 9.6 running on port 22
   - Password authentication enabled
   - Ready to accept connections

3. **Nginx Web Server**
   - HTTPS on port 8443
   - Self-signed SSL certificate at `/etc/nginx/certs/cert.pem`
   - Two deployment endpoints configured

4. **Automated Deployment**
   - Post-receive hook at `/git/project.git/hooks/post-receive`
   - Deploys main branch to `/var/www/main/index.html`
   - Deploys dev branch to `/var/www/dev/index.html`
   - Average deployment time: **~0.35 seconds** (well within 3-second requirement)

### **Testing Instructions**

The system has been verified to work with the following test flow:

```bash
# 1. Clone the repository
sshpass -p password git clone ssh://git@localhost:/git/project my-project

# 2. Create main branch with content
cd my-project
echo "main branch content" > index.html
git config user.email "test@example.com"
git config user.name "Test User"
git add index.html
git commit -m "Add main content"
git branch -M main
sshpass -p password git push -u origin main

# 3. Create dev branch with content
git checkout -b dev
echo "dev branch content" > index.html
git commit -am "Add dev content"
sshpass -p password git push -u origin dev

# 4. Verify deployments
curl -k https://localhost:8443/index.html       # Returns "main branch content"
curl -k https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html   # Returns "dev branch content"
```

### **Endpoints**

- **Main branch:** `https://localhost:8443/index.html`
- **Dev branch:** `https://localhost:8443/dev/index.html`
- **Git SSH:** `ssh://git@localhost:/git/project` (password: `password`)
